openings.claim: Question whether the paired-strip carrier has an attainable pressure range preventing sliding without rocking, including the right-contact card. Replace presumed balanced tightening with measured corner response; challenge pressure-to-friction action before acceptance.
openings.discriminator: Rival: added normal force restrains sliding by unloading the opposite corner, predicting reduced sliding accompanied by lift, possibly worsened by the card. Usable pressure predicts position within 1 mm and no damaging lift; neither is established. Persistent lift accompanying reduced sliding defeats balanced pressure.
openings.probe: First measure strip lengths, bolt clearance and rim access for capture and complete withdrawal without fixture alteration. If feasible within ninety minutes, test one clamp configuration through ten numbered opening/closure/20 N pull trials within twenty minutes, final closure with the supplied 1 mm card at the marked right contact. Record position, corner lift, release time and visible seal tears each cycle. Require position within 1 mm after ten cycles, resistance to 20 N and reopening by one technician within thirty seconds. Outcome failure rejects this configuration; stop on tears.
openings.uncertainty: Accessible underside geometry, sufficient strip stiffness and recoverable cord retention remain unverified. Geometry may prevent fabrication; three supplied corner-lift trials weaken safe friction. Measurements expose coupling but cannot establish failure of every possible tightening setting. Deployment awaits all valued outcome checks.

lineage.reason: Preserves the geometry gate, pressure-coupling question, rival prediction, defeat conditions and uncertainty.

decision: Probe feasibility, then pressure coupling; no feasible range or replacement is established. Retain existing hatch, rim and seal. No drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation of fixture; drill only supplied strips. Keep the full marked opening unobstructed, use no powered mechanism and recover loose components. No new materials or extra trials. Stay within two configurations/twelve total trials, each disturbed; only seal-contact continuity is waived for the final card. Require no new visible seal tears.
